name: the360hub-theme
description: Build tooling for The360Hub WordPress theme. The deployable theme lives in ./the360hub.

scripts.build: npm run build:fonts && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.check: node tools/check-contrast.mjs && node tools/check-size.mjs && npm run lint:php
scripts.lint:php: find the360hub -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l | grep -v '^No syntax errors' || true
